recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. The current specification correctly reflects FHIR-10437 after accounting for the FHIR-11279 application and the later ConceptMapRelationship refactor.
issue_request: FHIR-10437 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue asking to add a parent "related to" member to the DSTU2 ConceptMapEquivalence value set for mappings where precise equivalence was not asserted.
initial_application: The seed did not have a direct FHIR-10437 source commit; Jira resolved it as already done under another task. FHIR-11279 is the matching task, records svn revision 9925, and git commit b11f1f4131d2c977cef30cb82e26399fad2ecedc added `relatedto` to ConceptMapEquivalence and parented the specific equivalence codes beneath it.
additional_context: Later Published issues FHIR-22632 and FHIR-25923 retired ConceptMapEquivalence, introduced ConceptMapRelationship, and finalized current directional relationship codes. Those later decisions are already represented on the combined branch and preserve the requested concept as `related-to`.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current active source defines `related-to` in source/conceptmap/codesystem-concept-map-relationship.xml and binds ConceptMap relationship elements to ValueSet/concept-map-relationship, so restoring or editing the obsolete ConceptMapEquivalence surface would be incorrect.
